text: انتهت مباراة هاربور سيتي وسيبروك تاون بنتيجة 2-4 لصالح سيبروك تاون. بدأ هاربور سيتي المباراة بقوة وسجل هدفين متتاليين عبر إلياس أوكافور (فرصة تسجيل 0.111، تعني أن الهدف نادر الحدوث) ومارك باروس (فرصة تسجيل 0.009، هدف من بعيد ونادر) في الدقائق الأخيرة من الشوط الأول وبداية الثاني [#905] [#975]. مع ذلك، عاد سيبروك تاون بقوة بفضل ضغطهم وتصويبهم المباشر، فسجلوا أربع أهداف. كان لكْيان رومانو دور حاسم بهدفين متتاليين في الوقت بدل الضائع، هدفه الأول فرصة تسجيل 0.609، ما يعني هدف متوقع نسبياً [#1882] [#1906]. رغم الخسارة، كان مارك باروس أبرز لاعب في المباراة مع هدف، تمريرتين حاسمتين، وتسع اعتراضات [#975]. هذه المباراة تذكرنا كيف أن التغييرات في لعب الفريق و الضغط قد تقلب الموازين في اللحظات الأخيرة.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in ar

- Harbour City led 2-0 early with goals from Elias Okafor (xG 0.111, 45') and Marek Barros (xG 0.009, 47') but ultimately lost 2-4 to Seabrook Town [#905, #975].
- Seabrook Town outshot Harbour City 22 to 10, had higher xG of 3.48 vs 1.0, and converted late with two Kian Romano goals (xG 0.609 at 90+2' and 0.959 at 90+3') to clinch victory [#1882, #1906].
- Harsh tactical change by Seabrook at 65' increased press, directness, and line height, helping them reset to an attacking style leading to comeback goals [#1361].
- Marek Barros was MOTM despite playing for losing side, with 1 goal, 2 assists, 4 tackles, 9 interceptions, and a 9.8 rating [#975].
- Harbour City had a player sent off early (Joon Whitfield red card at 43'), likely impacting defensive solidity [#871].

- Harbour City built their opening goal through a patient, sustained passing maneuver lasting nearly a minute and involving 17 passes, characteristic of their 4-2-3-1 formation and patient short passing style. This reflects methodical buildup from defense to attack enabling Elias Okafor to score on a through ball by Marek Barros [#904, #905].

- Marek Barros extended Harbour City’s lead with a rare long-range goal initiated from a corner kick, showcasing a set-piece opportunism despite their generally short passing approach [#973, #975].

- Seabrook Town’s first goal came shortly after, scored by Tariq Marlowe immediately following a ball regain and a quick, direct attempt, demonstrating the effectiveness of their higher pressing and wide, crossing style from their 3-4-3 formation [#1103, #1104].

- After trailing 2-0, Seabrook Town’s coach adjusted tactics to increase pressing intensity, directness, and line height, aiming to chase the game by pressing higher and playing more direct football; this led to an equalizer by Callum Varga via a through ball after a quick transition from a regain, highlighting their tactical shift to overload and counter-pressing [#1361, #1447, #1448].

- In the dying moments, Seabrook Town capitalized on regained possession to launch rapid counter-attacks, scoring twice through Kian Romano assisted by quick through passes and short linking play, reflecting the high pressing, direct style and exploiting space behind Harbour City’s higher pressing defense who had also increased their press and directness while chasing the game [#1881, #1882, #1884, #1905, #1906].
